title: SC Braga vs Estoril: Reaction or Crisis in Liga Matchday 6
seoTitle: SC Braga vs Estoril: Reaction or Crisis in Matchday 6
subtitle: Clash at the Pedreira defines the Arsenalistas' response after defeat and Estoril's search for their first win.
excerpt: SC Braga hosts Estoril at the Pedreira looking to react after their defeat to Estrela da Amadora. Estoril seeks their first win in Liga Portugal 2026/27.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The clash between SC Braga and Estoril, scheduled for Monday, September 14, at 8:45 PM at the Estádio Municipal de Braga, marks the conclusion of matchday six of Liga Portugal 2026/27. The match is crucial for the home team, which seeks an immediate response after suffering its first defeat of the championship against Estrela da Amadora, while the opponent, currently in second-to-last place, fights to secure its first positive result of the season.

SC Braga's reaction after the slip-up

Head coach Carlos Vicens admitted that the team needs a change in attitude. He declared that he has prepared a "more aggressive" SC Braga for the match and does not get "euphoric in victories, nor desperate in defeats," emphasizing that mindset determines success. The manager expects a response from a team that feels hurt after the 2-1 defeat in the previous round, where Gabri Martínez opened the scoring for the Arsenalistas, but Ianis Stoica scored twice for Estrela da Amadora.

Estoril in search of their first victory

On the other side, Estoril, led by Vasco Matos, occupies 17th place with only two points. The "Canarinhos" coach describes the match as having a "high degree of difficulty, but challenging and motivating." Vasco Matos believes that the opponent's latest result will not make them any weaker and that the focus must be on internal work to translate production into goals and points. The team has yet to win in the competition, with two draws and three defeats.

Lineups and returning players

Carlos Vicens made four changes compared to the last match, bringing Adrian Barisic, Bright Arrey-Mbi, Gabriel Silva, and Jovan Milosevic into the starting lineup. There is also the return of Gorby and Ricardo Horta, who are available again after injuries, though they start on the bench. For Estoril, Vasco Matos made three changes, with the official debuts of Roko Jurisic, Milan Robin, and Nail Omerovic. Center-back Fabrício Garcia suffered an injury in the 10th minute and was replaced by Peixinho.

Recent performance and statistics

SC Braga enters the clash with seven points from four matches played, sitting in eighth place, and still has a game in hand against Gil Vicente. The team remains undefeated at home this season, with four consecutive victories without conceding. Estoril, on the other hand, is on a 13-match winless run across all competitions, increasing the pressure on Vasco Matos' squad.

Refereeing and match details

The match will be refereed by David Rafael Silva from the Porto Football Association, with Carlos Campos and Nélson Cunha as assistants. The video assistant referee (VAR) will be Hélder Malheiro, assisted by André Campos. The clash takes place at the Pedreira, SC Braga's stadium, wrapping up the matchday before the break for international fixtures.

With information from RTP, A Bola, NETVASCO.
